summary: The Lord of the Rings strategy/action entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC base game plus The Rise of the Witch-king, with community multiplayer/mod state documented

emulation.notes: Use native Windows PC or compatibility wrapper/VM if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC base game plus expansion at documented patch/settings

primary.version: PC base game plus The Rise of the Witch-king expansion
primary.why: The PC version is the core RTS route and The Rise of the Witch-king adds a new Angmar faction and campaign content. Xbox 360 is a notable console RTS port, but the PC route with expansion and community server/mod state documented is the complete archive path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC base game and Rise of the Witch-king expansion. Record disc/source, patch, widescreen/fix state, expansion version, campaign order, skirmish/War of the Ring settings, online/community-server route, and whether Xbox 360 was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for console control/interface comparison.
secondary.why: PC has the expansion and better RTS fidelity/control route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Post-official-server multiplayer preservation and balance/mod state
secondary.what_to_play: Document only with exact patch/mod/server state.
secondary.why: Official servers are shut down and community state varies.

all_releases.fidelity: Main RTS route with mouse/keyboard, mods, and compatibility fixes.

all_releases.platform: The Rise of the Witch-king expansion on Windows PC
all_releases.fidelity: Expansion adds Angmar faction, campaign, units, and War of the Ring changes.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for full official PC content.

all_releases.fidelity: Official servers shut down; community tools keep multiplayer possible.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The complete route needs the PC expansion and exact patch/server/mod state; Xbox 360 lacks the same PC expansion ecosystem.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record source, patch, expansion, widescreen fix, and online/community server state because official servers are shut down.

entries.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

emulation.emulator: None for PC; console emulation only for comparison
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Owned PC/home-console build with platform and co-op state documented

primary.why: EA's Return of the King game is a movie tie-in with no normal current storefront route; archive capture depends on owned PC/console media. The PC/PS2/Xbox/GameCube branch is the main co-op hack-and-slash route, while GBA/mobile versions are distinct adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC or console copy. Record platform, region, co-op state, character, mission path, unlocks/upgrades, difficulty, controller, online/LAN state if relevant, and whether GBA/mobile versions were excluded.

secondary.why: The main archive route is PC/home console.

all_releases.fidelity: Main co-op hack-and-slash movie tie-in route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC/home-console and handheld/mobile routes differ; current access is owned-copy dependent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record platform, co-op, mission path, and unlock state.
